description:
A researcher checking a performance claim needs to rerun its measurement on their own host.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/how-to/` shows how to reproduce a performance claim: building the benchmark environment, running the measurement, and comparing with the pinned receipt, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `benchmarks/README.md` and the benchmark scripts are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: Its worked example reproduces one claim from the performance evidence page by anchor.
- [hard] REQ-05: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the evidence reproduction how-to
